subject: Handover: TM-2026-0018 Motor Third Party Injury
body:
Claim TM-2026-0018 – Handover Note

Policyholder: R. Delaney
Claim: Motor, third party injury – junction collision, 11 March 2026
Handler: A. Wrenfield
Reserve: £14,500

Status

Letter of claim received from Marbury and Kean (28 April 2026, ref MK/PI/2026/1183) for whiplash associated disorder, bruising and eight physiotherapy sessions, with special damages of £2,370 plus vehicle hire.

Liability has been admitted. The insured's account matches the claimant's and there is no realistic defence. Reserve increased to £14,500 on 12 May to reflect the hire element.

Outstanding

The medical report from the claimant has not yet been served. Quantum cannot be assessed until this is received. Report was last chased on 20 June 2026.

Next step is to chase the medical report and then assess the quantum claim, particularly the hire element (eighteen days for the repair appears lengthy).
